paper_title: VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search
caption: The performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search. The performance gain is calculated via the performance gap between VisuoThink (w/o rollout search) and VisuoThink.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance gain (+%) achieved by VisuoThink on specific tasks through predictive rollout search, comparing two supervision regimes: Strong Supervision (represented by bars with diagonal stripes) and Weak Supervision (represented by solid light blue bars). The horizontal axis lists three distinct models: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, ordered from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "Performance Gain (+%)", is scaled linearly from 0 to 30, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. For each model, two adjacent bars are shown: the taller, diagonally striped bar corresponds to Strong Supervision, and the shorter, solid light blue bar corresponds to Weak Supervision. The performance gain for Strong Supervision on GPT-4o is approximately 24.5%, on Claude-3.5-Sonnet it is approximately 9.5%, and on Qwen2-72B-VL it is approximately 15%. The corresponding performance gains for Weak Supervision are approximately 5.5% for GPT-4o, approximately 3.5% for Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and approximately 5.5% for Qwen2-72B-VL. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the model names. There is no visual emphasis applied to any specific bar.
